name: lc3-assembly-ut
description: UT Austin internal build of the LC-3 assembly extension for ECE 306. Adds course-specific lab templates, textbook snippets, device-register helpers, sign-extension visualization, lc3tools tasks, and instructor tooling. Distributed via https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~abdonm/lc3-extension.html.

file.description: Path to the .asm file (defaults to the active editor).

lc3.diagnostics.enable.description: Enable real-time diagnostics and error checking.

lc3.diagnostics.warnUnusedLabels.description: Warn about labels that are defined but never referenced.

lc3.diagnostics.warnPCRelativeOverflow.description: Warn when a BR/LD/LDI/LEA/ST/STI/JSR target is too far away to fit in the PC-relative offset field. (Off-by-default to defer to lc3as if you prefer that workflow.)

lc3.hover.showEncoding.description: Show binary encoding format in hover tooltips.

lc3.lc3tools.binPath.description: Directory containing lc3as and lc3sim (or the lc3tools CLI). Leave empty to use whatever is on PATH.

lc3.lc3tools.useGUI.description: When running, prefer the lc3-tools GUI simulator (lc3sim-gui) over the terminal simulator (lc3sim).

lc3.honorCode.text.default:
; By submitting this file I affirm that I have neither given nor received
; unauthorized aid on this assignment, in accordance with The University of
; Texas at Austin Honor Code.
lc3.honorCode.text.description: Text inserted by the 'Insert UT Honor Code Block' command.

enumDescriptions: Never prompt. Students/instructors run the 'Insert UT Honor Code Block' command manually.
On the first save of a .asm in a workspace, ask whether to insert the block at the top.
Insert the block automatically on the first save of any .asm without prompting.
lc3.honorCode.promptOnFirstSave.description: Behavior on the first save of an LC-3 file in a workspace. Off by default — labs that don't use this fork's honor-code prompt aren't affected.
